name: Recorded arm M2–M4 gravity model, 2026-10-04
calibration: October 4 encoder mapping: 4096 counts/turn; at count 2048, M2=87°, M3=−75°, M4=15°; directions M2/M3 −1, M4 +1. Mapping is embedded in term weights and offsets.
mounting: Original arm mounted upright; unchanged joint directions, encoder offsets and link geometry.
payload: Empty gripper; no added payload. M1/M5/M6 compensation is explicitly zero.
status: Historical coefficients preserved. Basic six-motor v9 replay and gravity readback verified on 2026-10-24 with matching encoder calibration; full-travel and payload validation remain separate.
